value.title: Fan Appreciation Event: A Journey to Understanding the Human Heart
value.synopsis: Based on the survey of "scenes you want to see again" conducted on the official website, we look back on the protagonist Frieren's journey to understand the human heart, with a focus on three themes: "famous lines" that resonate with the heart, intense "battle scenes", and "humorous scenes" that make you laugh unintentionally.

value.title: Frieren: Journey's Memory Special Video
value.synopsis: Thank you for all of fan! A special video depicting the memories of Frieren's journey.

value.title: Yorushika "Haru" × "Funeral of Frieren" SPECIAL MUSIC VIDEO / Frieren OP Theme anime MV
Magia per farti dire quello che stai pensando
value.synopsis: Frieren, Heiter, and Eisen test the spell that causes the user to say whatever they are thinking on Himmel, who begins to wax-poetic about his looks aloud. The three of them agree that it would be unbearable to listen to it long term.

value.title: Magia per rimuovere l'alcool dalle bevande alcoliche
value.synopsis: After using the spell that removes just the alcohol from an alcoholic drink, Frieren, Himmel, and Eisen taste the drink and can't tell the difference. They then urge Heiter to try the drink, but he immediately guesses that the drink isn't alcoholic, to which the party all call him a Corrupt Priest.

value.title: Magia per svegliarsi all'orario giusto la mattina
value.synopsis: Fern is excited to try the spell because of Frieren's oversleeping habits. She sets the specified time to 6 AM. The next day, Frieren wakes up at the correct time, but the spell is unable to keep her from falling back asleep.

value.title: Magia per avere un buon profumo
value.synopsis: Frieren and Fern wonder what type of good smell the spell produces. They try it on Stark, and find that he smells like grilled meat. The two conclude that the smell is based on the user's definition of a good smell. Stark asks what's for dinner, and both Frieren and Fern exclaim that they want meat, scaring Stark.

value.title: Mini Anime "Magic of ??" / Special Edition: Magic to Make the Dining Table Happy
value.synopsis: Frieren's Party test the spell, which produces a bottle of Ajipon. They try the sauce with meat and find that it is delicious. Stark wonders if the sauce would taste good with dragon meat, and Frieren and Fern tell him to go defeat a dragon on his own so they can see. Mizkan Ajipon collaboration (advertisement)

value.title: Mini Anime "Magic of ??" / Vol. 5: Magic That Brings Good Luck
value.synopsis: Frieren's Party test the spell on Stark, who proceeds to have exceptional luck. The path they pick has no monsters and he wins a grand prize. Seeing this, Sein asks Frieren to cast the spell on him. He then goes gambling, but later returns with no clothes. Stark wonders if the spell didn't work, but Frieren says that Sein is just bad.

value.title: Mini Anime "Magic of ??" / Vol. 6: Magic to Remove Stubborn Oil Stains
value.synopsis: Sein has the idea of using the spell for profit by charging people who need tough oil stains removed from their pots and pans. However, because they offer to clean the first pot or pan for free, everyone only brings one pot or pan, and it ends up being volunteer work for Frieren.

value.title: Mini Anime "Magic of ??" / Vol. 7: Magic to Speak Extremely Fast Without Faltering
value.synopsis: Frieren and Heiter try the spell out on the taciturn Eisen. At first the spell doesn't seem to have worked, but when they ask him about a recent battle, both his speech and his movements increase in speed. Frieren and Heiter conclude that it's good for people to have their own manner of speech.

value.title: Mini Anime "Magic of ??" / Vol. 8: Magic to Understand a Fish's Feelings
value.synopsis: Frieren and Fern decide to test the spell on fish that Stark has caught while he gathers firewood. The fish speak pitifully and bemoan their family's bad luck, as their father was caught the day before. They wonder if they will be roasted or simmered. Frieren and Fern lose the appetite for fish and ask Stark to release them to his shock.
